post.x: one address holds 5.50 percent of every kaspa in circulation, about 1.52B KAS. at the current emission rate the entire network needs 808 days to mine that much. it has never been named.
post.reply: every move that wallet makes is on kaspapulse.com/entity-x.html. an address is not a person, one owner can hold many.
